result:
Both findings fixed.

## Files

| File | What |
|---|---|
| `chat/ComposerMenus.tsx` | `ModeMenu` gains optional `projectPermission`; a second `.chat-cmp-permnote` states the scope |
| `chat/Composer.tsx` | `projectPermissionMode?` prop + forward to `ModeMenu` (one prop, one line — no logic) |
| `ChatPane.tsx` | passes `projectPermissionMode={permissionMode}` beside the session truth; corrected the now-stale prop doc at `:482-492` |
| `AgentSurface.tsx` | `knownChatMode` filters `!r.disabled` |
| `scripts/verify/chat-composer-ui.mjs` | new `§9b` (+3 checks) |

**MAJOR 1** — the write is *not* re-scoped (that would orphan the vault default's only control, and the no-set-default rule forbids a second one). Both scopes are named instead. The note renders **always**, not only on divergence: a scope line that appears exactly when something is unusual teaches the user to read its absence as "this one is local" — the exact misreading it exists to prevent — and the click is project-wide either way.

**Non-blocking** — `CHAT_MODE_ROWS` carries the disabled J.A.R.V.I.S row so the capability can be announced as "Soon", so membership alone was too loose. Now matches `sanitizeChatMode`'s explicit `jarvis → basic` coercion (`agent-spawn-shared.ts:104`); otherwise the roster could hold a mode the spawn can never honour.

## New check — real output

```
── §9b the permission segment names BOTH scopes
  ✓ the menu states that a permission change reaches the whole project
  ✓ …and names the PROJECT default (bypass) …
  ✓ …while the segment still shows THIS session (auto) — the scopes are named, not merged
```

Driven in the one genuinely divergent state: a hand-off session running `auto` inside a `bypass`-remembered vault.

**Gates:** `ROOT_TSC=0`, `DASH_TSC=0`, `BUILD_EXIT=0`, vitest `48 passed (48)`, verify **✅ 47 passed, 0 failed** (was 44).

## Deviations

1. **`Composer.tsx` was touched** — the grant named `ComposerMenus.tsx`, but `ChatPane → Composer → ModeMenu` has no other path. Confined to one optional prop and one forward.
2. **§9b failed on its first run** and was right to: I'd edited source without rebuilding, and the script serves `dist/`. `npm run build` fixed it — worth noting because it means any future fix round here needs a rebuild before the verify script means anything.
